S0411.reason: We can set up a system of linear equations: daps = 7/4 yaps and yaps = 3/5 baps. Solving this system gives daps / baps = (7/4)(3/5) = 21/20. Multiplying both sides by 420 gives the number of daps in terms of baps, which is 840. Since there are only 42 baps, the number of daps must be 21.
